_comment: STAShield Pterodactyl egg for STA Cloud internal/private deployment.
name: STAShield
author: STA Cloud
description: STAShield is STA Cloud's private Minecraft Java protection proxy for Pterodactyl. The proxy listens on this server's primary allocation port and forwards allowed Minecraft traffic to the configured backend Minecraft server allocation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
cd /mnt/server

CONFIG_FILE=${CONFIG_FILE:-stashield.toml}
SERVER_JARFILE=${SERVER_JARFILE:-STAShield.jar}
BACKEND_TARGET_HOST=${BACKEND_HOST:-AUTO}
if [ "${BACKEND_TARGET_HOST}" = "AUTO" ]; then
  BACKEND_TARGET_HOST=${SERVER_IP}
fi

if [ -n "${STASHIELD_JAR_URL:-}" ]; then
  echo "Downloading STAShield jar from ${STASHIELD_JAR_URL}"
  curl -L --fail -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${STASHIELD_JAR_URL}"
else
  echo "No STASHIELD_JAR_URL configured. Using jar embedded in the STA Cloud Docker image or existing ${SERVER_JARFILE}."
fi

if [ ! -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]; then
  echo "Creating ${CONFIG_FILE}"
  cat > "${CONFIG_FILE}" <<EOF
[server]
bind_host = "0.0.0.0"
bind_port = ${SERVER_PORT}
backlog = 256
connect_timeout_ms = 5000
read_timeout_ms = 10000
max_packet_bytes = ${MAX_PACKET_BYTES:-2097152}
max_connections = ${MAX_CONNECTIONS:-2048}

[backend]
host = "${BACKEND_TARGET_HOST}"
port = ${BACKEND_PORT:-25565}

[protection]
enabled = true
rate_limit_per_ip = ${RATE_LIMIT_PER_IP:-8}
burst_limit_per_ip = ${BURST_LIMIT_PER_IP:-24}
burst_window_ms = ${BURST_WINDOW_MS:-3000}
bot_score_threshold = ${BOT_SCORE_THRESHOLD:-70}
max_active_logins_per_ip = ${MAX_ACTIVE_LOGINS_PER_IP:-3}

[access]
whitelist_enabled = false
whitelist = []
blacklist = []

[metrics]
enabled = true
log_interval_seconds = 30
EOF
else
  echo "${CONFIG_FILE} already exists; leaving it unchanged."
fi

echo "STAShield install complete"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Local jar name used when the selected Docker image does not already include /opt/stashield/STAShield.jar.

variables.name: STAShield Jar URL
variables.description: Optional private URL used by the install script to download STAShield.jar into /home/container. Leave empty when using the STA Cloud Docker image with the jar embedded.

variables.name: Config File
variables.description: STAShield TOML config file path relative to /home/container.

variables.name: Backend Host
variables.description: Use AUTO to forward to this STAShield server's primary allocation IP / node IP. Set a concrete IP or hostname only if the backend is on another reachable node.

variables.name: Backend Port
variables.description: Allocation port of the real Minecraft backend server to protect. This is not the STAShield proxy port; each Pterodactyl backend server/user may have a different allocation.

variables.name: Max Packet Bytes
variables.description: Maximum first Minecraft packet payload size accepted by STAShield.

variables.name: Max Connections
variables.description: Maximum active TCP connections allowed by the STAShield process.

variables.name: Rate Limit Per IP
variables.description: Allowed new connections per IP per second before STAShield blocks the source.

variables.name: Burst Limit Per IP
variables.description: Allowed new connections per IP inside the configured burst window.

variables.name: Bot Score Threshold
variables.description: Bot score threshold from 1 to 100. Sources at or above this score are blocked.

variables.name: Max Active Logins Per IP
variables.description: Maximum concurrent login-state connections allowed per IP.
